title: Rebello's tweet promising to open Brazil's UFO archives if the US does

tellings.quote: I know what the armed forces have in their archives. What I can say is that if the US government reveals its documents, I will do the same if I am elected president of Brazil.

plain: A Brazilian politician named Aldo Rebelo, described in the episode's title as a defense minister, posted on social media that he knows what Brazil's armed forces hold in their archives on UFOs, and promised to open them if the United States opens its own. Michels quotes the post himself: "What I can say is that if the US government reveals its documents, I will do the same if I am elected president of Brazil." If he meant it, it would mean a senior Brazilian official is saying his country's military has UFO files worth releasing.
